+## [1.6.0](https://github.com/szTheory/sigra/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0) (2026-10-08)
+
+### Added
+
+- Generated email-confirmation screens accept pasted six-digit codes with spaces, let users retry after an invalid code, and explain when a confirmation link has expired or was already used.
+- Branding profiles support a separate dark-theme logo. When no dark accent is configured, Sigra preserves an accent that already meets contrast and adjusts only its lightness when needed; the admin customizer shows how the dark accent was resolved.
+- OAuth callbacks can opt into returning validated provider identity evidence, including issuer, subject, and authentication time when available.
+- Chimeway auth-message integrations support opaque recipient references and resolve magic-link tokens before recipient lookup.
+
+### Upgrade notes
+
+Existing generated files remain host-owned; updating the dependency does not overwrite customized confirmation screens. Existing apps can selectively adopt the generated confirmation LiveView changes from the [v1.6 upgrade guide](guides/introduction/upgrading-to-v1.6.md), while fresh installs receive the current output. The confirmation recovery changes require no database migration.
+

+# Upgrade to Sigra v1.6.0
+
+This guide is for existing Phoenix applications that already use Sigra. Sigra 1.6.0 improves generated email-confirmation recovery: users can paste six-digit codes with spaces, retry after an invalid code, and see when a confirmation link has expired or was already used. Update the dependency for library-owned changes, then selectively adopt the generated confirmation LiveView changes if your host was generated before 1.6.0. See the [1.6.0 changelog entry](../../CHANGELOG.md#160-2026-10-08) for the release details.
+
+## Compatibility
+
+The package constraints in `mix.exs` are Elixir `~> 1.18`, Phoenix `~> 1.8`, Phoenix LiveView `~> 1.1`, Ecto `~> 3.12`, and Ecto SQL `~> 3.12`. These constraints describe versions the package accepts; they do not mean CI tests every version in each range.
+
+The required pull-request CI run uses the repository toolchain in [`.tool-versions`](https://github.com/szTheory/sigra/blob/main/.tool-versions): Elixir 1.19.5 on Erlang/OTP 28.5. Its fresh-host smoke uses Phoenix 1.8.8 and the default `mix sigra.install` output. Optional install-flag coverage runs only on non-pull-request events and is not part of the required pull-request CI receipt.
+
+## Update the dependency
+
+From your host application's root, set the dependency to:
+
+```elixir
+{:sigra, "~> 1.6.0"}
+```
+
+Refresh the lockfile, confirm the resolved package, and run your host checks:
+
+```bash
+mix deps.update sigra
+mix deps.tree
+mix test
+```
+
+Confirm that the dependency tree reports Sigra 1.6.0, then commit the updated `mix.lock` with the dependency change. The version remains a release candidate until publication; before it is available from Hex, validate against the reviewed PR source. The candidate CI workflow also builds documentation with warnings treated as errors.
+
+## Adopt generated confirmation changes
+
+Updating Sigra supplies library-owned behavior, including confirmation token handling. It does not rewrite files copied into your application by `mix sigra.install`. Sigra 1.6.0 updates the generated confirmation LiveView with pasted-code handling and retryable feedback. Existing hosts that want this recovery behavior should compare their generated `lib/<app>_web/live/confirmation_live.ex` with the v1.6.0 installer output and selectively adopt the relevant changes. Preserve application-specific markup and policy while reviewing that diff. Do not rerun the installer with `--force` over customized files. A fresh installation already receives the current generated output.
+
+## Migration and `mix sigra.upgrade`
+
+The 1.6.0 confirmation changes add no schema fields or migration steps, so they require no database migration. You also do not need to run `mix sigra.upgrade` solely to adopt these changes. That task handles explicit schema and data upgrades; use it only when a release instruction or your existing schema version calls for one.
+
+## Troubleshooting
+
+- **The app still resolves Sigra 1.5.x:** confirm the host dependency uses `~> 1.6.0`, rerun `mix deps.update sigra`, and commit the changed lockfile.
+- **Pasted confirmation codes or retry feedback are missing:** compare the host-owned generated confirmation LiveView with the v1.6.0 installer output and selectively adopt its relevant changes; updating Hex dependencies cannot update that file.
+- **The confirmation page behaves differently after adoption:** run host tests around signed-out and signed-in confirmation, malformed codes, expired links, and retry feedback, then review custom changes in the generated LiveView.
